title: Стартовая материализация G5 v1
scope: Specification, contracts, prompts, validation and DB write plan for materializing the first G5 scene graph inside an existing G4 location at new-party start.
non_goals: No precreation of full G5 map
No runtime creation of new G1-G4 nodes
No item materialization from player request alone

template_metadata.purpose: Шаблоны G5-сцен для всех типов G4-локаций карты Новгородской земли
template_metadata.list_expansion_policy: Списки задания являются минимальным ядром, а не пределом. Новые контейнеры, слухи, события, предметные и социальные профили допустимы только при историко-бытовом, хозяйственном или социальном основании, со статусом, уверенностью и возможностью ручного аудита.

materialization_policy.extension_policy: Списки задания являются минимальным ядром, а не пределом. Новые контейнеры, слухи, события, предметные и социальные профили допустимы только при историко-бытовом, хозяйственном или социальном основании, со статусом, уверенностью и возможностью ручного аудита.

pipeline.input_sources: new_party_generator output; party_state; party_places; party_locations; world_base.graph_nodes; novgorod_g5_scene_templates_v1
pipeline.validation_gates: party_id, character_id, region_id, place_id, location_id, canonical_g4_node_id/g4_type_id, season, time, weather, start cause are present; no G1-G4 creation here.
pipeline.repair_on_fail: Return missing or inconsistent context to new-party generator; do not create fallback location in code.
pipeline.hidden_allowed: yes, for already approved hidden start state only
pipeline.notes: This step freezes the target G4; all G5 nodes must be children of it.

pipeline.validation_gates: Exact g4_type_id match preferred; category fallback requires needs_review issue; allowed/required/forbidden anchor lists copied from template, not invented.
pipeline.repair_on_fail: Ask LLM/template editor for matching G4 template; do not use generic scene anchors if no template exists.
pipeline.notes: Template is a limit and causal frame, not a precreated G5 map.

pipeline.input_sources: party_minilocations; party_scene_anchors; party_items; party_npcs; party_graph_nodes; party_graph_edges
pipeline.validation_gates: Existing facts cannot be silently overwritten; duplicate anchor/item/NPC risks identified before drafting new G5.
pipeline.repair_on_fail: Return to LLM with locked facts and require reuse/update rather than duplicate materialization.
pipeline.notes: Needed for returning to an existing scene or resuming after partial start generation.

pipeline.input_sources: G5StartInputContext; G5TemplateMatch; G5ExistingStateSnapshot; time/season/weather; place function; PC status
pipeline.validation_gates: At least one minilocation and one primary scene anchor; all anchors inside selected G4; no forbidden anchor types; required anchor categories covered; generation limits observed.
pipeline.repair_on_fail: Ask LLM to rebuild anchors within allowed template lists and explicit causal basis.
pipeline.hidden_allowed: yes, but split visible/hidden fields in contract
pipeline.notes: This is the main semantic materialization step. Code must not choose anchors.

pipeline.input_sources: G5SceneGraphDraft; item/property rules; NPC presence; light/weather/status/time
pipeline.validation_gates: Each significant anchor has visibility, access, owner/controller/holder when relevant, witnesses and risk; hidden facts have visible signs only when justified.
pipeline.repair_on_fail: Return anchors without owner/access/risk/visibility to LLM for completion; remove ungrounded hidden objects.
pipeline.player_visible: no; only filtered visible package later
pipeline.notes: Prevents empty anchors and unfair hidden objects.

pipeline.human_stage: Привязка предметов и людей к G5
pipeline.input_sources: G5AnchorAccessVisibilityPackage; item profiles; container profiles; NPC profile rules; existing party state
pipeline.validation_gates: Items and NPCs are attached to anchor/minilocation with materialization reason; significant items have placement/owner/holder/access/risk; NPC depth matches memory need.
pipeline.repair_on_fail: Require materialization reason or drop item/NPC from start scene; do not create inventory/object from player wish alone.
pipeline.notes: Binding may update existing NPC/item rows or create party-level rows when LLM approves them.

pipeline.input_sources: G5SceneGraphDraft; G5ObjectNpcBinding; graph_scale_rules G5; selected G4 location access
pipeline.validation_gates: Each edge connects two G5 nodes in same selected G4; base_time_minutes is 0-5; access/risk/visibility conditions are explicit; reverse edge specified when movement is reversible.
pipeline.repair_on_fail: Return impossible or out-of-range edges to LLM; no code-side edge guessing.
pipeline.notes: G5 edges handle seconds/minutes, doors, thresholds, short approach, hiding places and witness line-of-sight.

pipeline.validation_gates: selected anchor exists; position_visible_text is consistent; full region/place/location/minilocation/anchor/current_node chain can be written.
pipeline.repair_on_fail: Ask LLM to choose a valid existing draft anchor or rebuild G5 graph.
pipeline.notes: This produces the first actionable physical position of the player character.

pipeline.input_sources: All G5 draft/audit contracts; PC knowledge; UI rules; hidden state
pipeline.validation_gates: No hidden motives, hidden objects, future events, exact internal calculations or full objective map leak into player-facing package.
pipeline.repair_on_fail: Return leak list to visibility selector; strip or convert hidden facts to visible signs only.
pipeline.hidden_allowed: yes, only to exclude it from output
pipeline.player_visible: yes after prose writer uses only this package
pipeline.notes: This is the only G5 package allowed to reach intro prose.

pipeline.input_sources: All prior contracts; party schema; repair/audit pipeline rules
pipeline.validation_gates: No blocking issues: FK plan complete; no G1-G4 runtime creation; no template violation; no visibility leak; no missing required fields.
pipeline.repair_on_fail: Block commit and send focused repair prompt to the failing agent.

pipeline.writes_to_party_tables: party_graph_nodes; party_graph_edges; party_minilocations; party_scene_anchors; party_items; party_npcs; party_current_position; party_map_knowledge; party_llm_steps
pipeline.validation_gates: Atomic transaction; all FK targets exist; no partial visible scene without current_position; failed commit rolls back and records validation issue.
pipeline.repair_on_fail: Rollback; return SQL/FK/constraint issue to LLM or schema implementer depending on cause.
pipeline.player_visible: no; next stage prose uses G5VisibleStartPackage
pipeline.notes: The commit code writes only accepted plan; it does not invent missing fields.

contracts.blocking_validations: complete G4 context; no runtime G1-G4 creation
exact template match or explicit needs_review fallback
no silent overwrite of existing party facts
anchors inside G4; allowed anchor types; no forbidden anchors
visibility/access/ownership/risk complete for each significant anchor
items/NPCs have causal basis and anchor placement
G5 edges same parent G4 and 0-5 minutes
commit_allowed must be true for DB write

validation_rules.rule: Start context must include party_id, character_id, region_id, place_id, location_id, canonical_g4_node_id or explicit party_location_id, g4_type_id, season, time and cause.
G4 type must match a G5 template. Category fallback is allowed only with needs_review validation issue; no generic anchors.
G5 materialization must not create new G1-G4 nodes or change canonical graph.
Every minilocation, scene anchor and G5 edge must belong to the selected G4 location.
Required anchor categories from the matched template must be covered or explicitly waived by an audit issue.
No anchor may match forbidden anchor types: magic, modern object, quest marker, ownerless treasure, new G4 node.
Every significant anchor must have visibility, access, ownership/control, witness and risk fields.
Items can only be created with causal reason and allowed place/profile category; player request alone is insufficient.
G5 edge base_time_minutes must be between 0 and 5 unless explicitly blocked as impossible.
party_current_position must include region_id, place_id, location_id, minilocation_id, anchor_id and current_node_id.
Visible package must not include hidden motives, hidden items, exact future events, objective map or internal calculations.
Commit is blocked if any prior blocking validation failed.
DB writes must be atomic; partial G5 scene without current_position is invalid.
Draft/needs_review source status is preserved; source confidence cannot be upgraded by materialization.

prompts.task: Extract and lock the selected start G4 location and all required current party context for G5 materialization.
prompts.guardrails: Do not invent or select a new G4. Return an error list if context is incomplete.

prompts.task: Find the exact G5 template for the selected g4_type_id and return its allowed, required, optional and forbidden anchor constraints.
prompts.guardrails: Do not use a generic scene if no template is found. Do not expand anchor lists without explicit source and audit flag.

prompts.task: Create a causally grounded G5 scene graph inside the selected G4 using the matched template and locked party context.
prompts.guardrails: No new G1-G4 nodes. No modern/fantasy anchors. Every anchor must help process visibility, access, movement, witnesses, items or interaction.

prompts.role: аудитор видимости, доступа, владения и риска
prompts.task: Audit each G5 anchor for what is visible, accessible, owned/controlled, witnessed and risky.
prompts.guardrails: Hidden facts must not be converted into visible facts. If hidden has a sign, pass only the sign.

prompts.role: агент привязки предметов и NPC к G5
prompts.task: Bind initial items, containers and NPCs to scene anchors only where the G4 function, situation and template justify them.
prompts.guardrails: Player request does not materialize items. Significant objects require owner/holder/access/risk.

prompts.task: Define short movement edges between G5 anchors and minilocations with time, access, visibility and risk.
prompts.guardrails: G5 edge time must be 0-5 minutes and stay inside selected G4.

prompts.task: Select the exact starting anchor and produce complete current_position fields.
prompts.guardrails: The selected anchor must exist in the G5 draft. Position cannot be prose-only.

prompts.role: агент безопасного видимого пакета стартовой сцены
prompts.hidden_allowed: yes, only to exclude hidden information
prompts.task: Prepare the visible-only package for intro prose after G5 materialization.
prompts.guardrails: Do not reveal hidden motives, hidden objects, exact future events, objective map, raw JSON or internal calculations.

prompts.task: Decide if the G5 materialization can be committed to party DB.
prompts.guardrails: Block commit on any missing FK plan, template violation, G1-G4 mutation, visibility leak or missing current_position.

prompts.task: Transform accepted G5 contracts into DB write plan.
prompts.guardrails: Only structure accepted facts. Do not add new anchors, items, NPCs or routes.

error_codes.meaning: No exact G5 template for selected G4 type.
Draft includes forbidden or modern/fantasy anchor.
Anchor, minilocation or edge is outside selected G4.
G5 edge time is not 0-5 minutes.
Item was created without causal reason or profile support.
Draft duplicates existing party state instead of reusing/updating.
Draft tries to upgrade source status/confidence.
